newsitem.title: USA: Oneida to sell Camden unit to International Wire.
newsitem.headline: Oneida to sell Camden unit to International Wire.

text.p: Oneida Ltd said on Thursday it entered into a new agreement to sell its Camden Wire Co unit to International Wire Group Inc, in a transaction valued at about $60 million.

Oneida said the new plan replaced a previous agreement to sell Camden to a unit of Aarque Capital Corp in a transaction valued at about $51 million. The company said the terms of the Aarque agreement allowed Oneida to consider alternative offers by other parties.
The new agreement would result in an after-tax gain for Oneida of about $3.5 million or $0.32 per share, it said.
